content: अप्रयुक्त {%a.%} .²1 Not used or employed, not applied. .²2 Wrongly used, as a word. .²3 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) Rare, unusual (as a word when used in a particular sense or gender though that sense or gender be sanctioned by lexicographers); अप्रयुक्तं तथाम्नातमपि कविभिर्नादृतम्; तथा मन्ये दैवतोऽस्य पिशाचो राक्षसोऽथवा . where the mas. gender of दैवत, though sanctioned (by Amara), is not used by poets and is, therefore, अप्रयुक्त. सन्त्यप्रयुक्ताः <ls>Mbh.</ls>
